infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Grittt to access your photos to track your food.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Grittt to use your camera to snap and track food.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Allow Grittt to read your steps, heart rate, sleep, weight, and workouts from Health so it can build a fuller picture of your discipline.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Allow Grittt to save workouts you log in the app back to Health.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GRITTT uses your microphone only when you start a voice log. Send the recording for transcription, review it, then choose whether to save.
